summary: A recording now opens as a player: the picture fills the window over a slim transport, with no tool bar, tracks or panel. View | Edit at the right of the title bar, Cmd-1, Cmd-2 or E brings the whole editor back, and starting any edit switches to Edit by itself.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/view-mode-and-edit-mode-walk.json.

try.do: Open a screen recording from the Finder.
Press space to play, then space to stop; click the picture (nothing gets picked).
Click Edit in the title bar, or press Cmd-2.
Press E twice to go to View and back, then Cmd-1 for View.
In View, press I to mark an In: the editor comes up by itself.
Leave it in Edit, close the window, and open the recording again.
In View, double click the picture, or press the arrows button at the far right of the transport, for full screen.

evaluate: Does a recording you just opened feel like QuickTime rather than an editor?
Is the View | Edit switch where your hand goes, and is it the right size next to the panel toggle?
Does going to Edit and back feel smooth, with nothing jumping, on the recordings you actually open?
Should T, R and the other tool letters in View switch to Edit and pick the tool (as now), or do nothing?
Is losing the Layers list for a recording (the timeline is the list in Edit, and View has no panel) fine?
rough: There is no mock page for View mode; it was built from the task's words. Edit mode is the existing video.html layout unchanged.
On a five minute recording with captions the first frame of the switch to Edit takes about 180 ms, so the slide-in stutters. Filed as its own task.

The transport in View is the editor's transport plus a full screen button, so it still has Go to Start and Go to End; the volume is still the mute button and meter (the working volume slider is a separate task).
The timeline's x and Option-Command-T now switch to View rather than tucking the tracks to one row; the one-row TIMELINE rail is gone.
On a recording, Actual Size moved from Cmd-1 to Option-Command-0 so Cmd-1 can be View.
The Layers list used to come back when the tracks were tucked; with no tucked state it no longer shows for a recording, and the walk about its piece count was retired.
